name: π-Bench
intro: π-Bench 是一个评估主动式个人助手在长程、多会话工作流中表现的基准。它包含 5 类 persona 下的 100 个多轮任务，任务运行在持久工作区中，用户需求通常不完整且会逐步显现，用于同时衡量 Agent 的任务完成度和主动发现隐藏意图的能力。
build_method: Persona构建, 多轮任务设计, 持久工作区仿真
task_type: 主动助手任务, 长程规划, 多会话工作流
eval_feature: 隐藏意图, 跨会话连续性, 任务依赖, 主动性
task_type_en: Proactive assistant task, Long-horizon planning, Multi-session workflow
build_method_en: Persona construction, multi-turn task design, persistent workspace simulation
eval_feature_en: Hidden intents, cross-session continuity, task dependencies, proactivity
intro_en: π-Bench evaluates proactive personal assistant agents in long-horizon, multi-session workflows. It contains 100 multi-turn tasks across 5 personas in persistent workspaces where user requirements are often underspecified and emerge over time, jointly measuring task completion and whether agents discover or infer hidden intents early.
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Define five domain personas with stable roles, routines, preferences, and long-term goals"] --> B["Create one persistent 20-session episode for each persona in a shared project workspace"]
    B --> C["Derive workflow-grounded tasks from authentic routines, supporting materials, files, tools, and skills"]
    C --> D["Write natural underspecified initial requests or environment-triggered starts for each session"]
    D --> E["Annotate recoverable hidden intents separately from visible user requests"]
    D --> F["Create checklist criteria and rule- or rubric-based graders for final task completion"]
    E --> G["Run turn-based simulated user-agent sessions while tracking intent terminal status"]
    F --> G
    G --> H["Iteratively inspect leakage, recoverability, tool setup, workspace paths, and grader stability"]
    H --> I["Report Proactivity from agent-resolved intents and Completeness from checklist satisfaction"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["定义五类领域persona，包含稳定角色、习惯、偏好和长期目标"] --> B["为每个persona创建共享项目工作区中的20会话持久episode"]
    B --> C["从真实工作例程、支撑材料、文件、工具和skill派生工作流任务"]
    C --> D["为每个会话编写自然但欠规格的初始请求或环境触发任务"]
    D --> E["将可恢复隐藏意图与可见用户请求分开标注"]
    D --> F["为最终任务完成创建checklist和规则/模型rubric评分器"]
    E --> G["运行轮流式模拟用户-代理会话并跟踪意图终态"]
    F --> G
    G --> H["迭代检查泄漏、可恢复性、工具配置、工作区路径和评分器稳定性"]
    H --> I["用代理解决的隐藏意图计算Proactivity，用checklist满足度计算Completeness"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2605.14678 and the Pi-Bench project page. The paper describes five user roles, one 20-session episode per role, and 100 tasks in persistent project workspaces. Tasks are derived from domain experts authentic work routines and supporting materials, then reviewed for realism and feasibility. Each session starts from an underspecified request or environment trigger; hidden intents are annotated as recoverable latent requirements, while checklist items define verifiable final outcomes. Rule-based and rubric-based graders score completeness, a simulated user tracks hidden-intent terminal status through turn-based interaction, and quality control checks leakage, recoverability, tool bindings, workspace paths, and grader stability.
